# ThreadSanitizer suppressions for the backend's own CI (see the
# "sanitizers" job in workflows/build-and-test.yml). Keep these narrow:
# each one should name the single test that races on purpose, never a
# library function, or real races in that code would be hidden too.

# GenericFIFO lets reset() run while a read() and write() are in flight.
# A read or write that overlaps a reset still copies to or from the
# buffer, but its commit then fails (reset() bumps the generation) and
# what it copied is thrown away, like a seqlock. That copy is a data race
# by the C++ memory model, and this test exists to make it happen as
# often as possible; whether the FIFO stays consistent is what it checks.
race:testConcurrentResetRace
